The '''Shifting Path''' was a roadway that led from [[Outpost Thorazan]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] to the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
